Title: Azure Private Link is now available for multiple new Azure services

Body.Content:
Azure Private Link is now generally available for these services:

  • Azure Cognitive Search
  • Azure Event Hubs
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Azure Backup
  • Azure Container Registry
  • Azure Event Grid topics
  • Azure Event Grid domains

Private Link is also available in preview for these services:

  • Azure SignalR Service
  • Azure IoT Hub

Check regional availability of supported services.

Get started with quickstarts and tutorials for Azure portal, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.

Learn more about connecting to a Private Link resource through a private endpoint.
